x: The 100 yards Veterans resulted in only four runners facing the starter; and that old war-horse, Dick Best, added to his list of "pots" by annexing first prize.

Thus, Oscar Horwood, a schoolmate, Harry Goodfellow, Ernie Musselbrook (then in Kennington Harriers), Dick Best and others were his contemporaries; and Harry soon showed himself a useful performer and displayed his tremendous sense of team spirit and solidarity, combined with a desire to be of help…
This event was held at Weybridge and our scoring team was:- HARRY PARKER 15, OSCAR HORWOOD 16, DICK BEST 17, and ERNIE MUSSELBROOK 18 - five seconds covering the four runners.
